notes.title: Minor update. Grenade Launcher no longer sucks.
notes.content:
Grenade launcher was bugged and not causing damage most of the time.

Fix radial damage blockers.

Remove unused analytics events.

notes.title: Update Log – The Maw Widens
notes.content:
Update Log – The Maw Widens

The veil grows thinner. In our ongoing efforts to fortify sanity and sharpen steel, the following changes have been enacted:

The rogue incantations (debug keys) have been purged—no longer shall they summon chaos where none was intended.

Wretched spawn no longer remain frozen in dread. Stuck zombies now resume their cursed path.

Melee strikes now echo with fury. Camera effects have been infused to reflect the bone-crunching weight of each impact.

The Hell Pit breathes. Entering it now distorts perception with its own vile camera effects.

Lateral motion—right or left—summons sweeping strikes. But when you stand firm, unmoving, it is the overhead blow that answers the void—delivered with the weight of finality.

Main Menu adjusted. Subtle shifts... perhaps you won’t notice, but something is watching.

The mark has changed. A new project icon now brands this world.

Visions upon awakening are new. Splash screens replaced with fresher horrors.

And as always, miscellaneous anomalies and minor corruptions have been smoothed over—though not all were willing to go quietly.

Hold your breath. Steel your mind. The deeper realms are stirring.

notes.title: A little more boom, and life as a Scion of the Black Sun gets a tiny bit easier.
notes.content:
Another very small patch this morning.

[list]
[*] Fixes for controller navigation on some of the menus.
[*] Added camera shake volume to some of the exploding enemies.
[*] Started work on melee pushback (it's not perfect, weird things might happen, and it needs to be reworked further)
[*] Fixed a possible quest break if an easter egg was unlocked before one of the goals.
[*] Tweaks to time dilation for the player
[*] updated bombs to fix a UI marker and outline issue
[*] adjusted fire AOE life span so the damage effect doesn't outlast the visual
[*] minor menu tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: More boom to the boom and it's starting to feel like a game.
notes.content:
A small patch this morning.

I've started adding in bullet time. What's there now is a bit basic but it's part of a more complex player ability system that's in the works. 

Tweaked melee a bit more. It's still not final and there's a lot more to come.

Added some placeholder sounds for the player.

Added some VFX, Camera effects, and a few more minor tweaks.

More to come, very soon, as always.

notes.title: Smackity Smack Smash. Melee gets Wet.
notes.content:
Added visual and audio effects to melee impacts and improved overall feel. There's more to come with a selection of melee weapons and the ability to switch attacks based on movement. 
But for now, it's pretty fun smashing some zombie skulls with a barbed wire bat.

notes.title: Minor update. WIP Melee system.
notes.content:
Small patch. 
-Changed out the melee system, the new system needs some tweaking, better sounds, and better physics reactions to hits but I'll sort that out in the morning. It's been a long day, I'm tired but wanted to go ahead and push the new system as is since the current melee sucks.

-Also, reduced ammo costs to help prevent new players from running out of money but might raise it back once the new melee setup gets a bit more polish.

-adjusted mouse capture during gameplay to hopefully fix an issue where the mouse was losing focus on the game in some situations.

-big zombies received more health and a minor reduction to base movement speed.

-dogs and bugs received a minor increase to base speed.

-spawn rate from wave 8 and up increased in beta level.

and a few other minor fixes and tweaks here and there.

Thanks again for all the feedback and I'll have another update or two tomorrow.

notes.title: Entering Open Beta
notes.content:
🛠️ Necro Siege Enters Open Beta – New Demo Available Now!
Greetings, Operators!

I'm excited to announce that Necro Siege has officially entered Open Beta, and with it comes a brand-new demo packed with fresh updates, gameplay improvements, and all-new visual branding!

This marks a major milestone in development as I continue refining the core gameplay experience based on your feedback.

🆕 What’s New in This Update:
• 🔫 Updated combat and balancing
• 🧠 Smarter enemy AI and improved wave pacing
• 🎨 New marketing artwork and UI enhancements
• 🎮 New Open Beta Demo now live on the store page

Whether you're a returning player or jumping in for the first time, there's plenty to explore in the latest build. I'm counting on your feedback to help shape the next phase of development—so jump in, test it out, and let me know what you think!

This update focuses on refining enemy AI and balancing enemy movement speed, attacks, and spawn rates. 

👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3163140/Necro_Siege_Demo/]Try the new demo here[/url]
📢 Join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/4b5FnSKwjR]Discord[/url] and let me know what you'd like to see next.

I have a new map in the works to test out another game mode that I'm looking forward to sharing it with all of you very soon. Also, I'm working on some new content to help bring the world of Necro Siege to life as well as share the story behind the evil that the player is facing.

Thank you for your continued support and talk to you again soon,
– AT
